description: Géoportail: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géoportail. Coverage: Géoportail. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Annex I Theme Transport Networks - Roads - RoadNode - Electrical Charg; Annex III - Utility and governmental services - ElectricityNetwork App; Annex III Theme Energy Resources - Wind turbines; Annex III - Utility and governmental services - ElectricityNetwork Uti. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
